correctness.rationale: Fourier orthogonality turns ∫|P|^{2s} into squared convolution coefficients, allowing entrywise majorization by moduli. The Laurent constant term is nondecreasing in every nonnegative autocorrelation R1,R2,R3. Reflection/RMS replacing magnitudes by (A,B,B,A) keeps R0 fixed and increases all others by Cauchy/AM-GM for every s≥2. For s=3 exact ratio F(t) has derivative sign controlled by t^5+4t^4+t^3−6t−4 (one positive root by Descartes); all boundary ratios are smaller, strict autocorrelation equalities enforce A=d,B=c and convolution phases affine. An independent symbolic expansion/derivative check passed. The universality follows from algebra, not from finite grids.
